title: Envelope Pouch
description: A sweet little drawstring pouch with a fold-over envelope top. Great for storing small treasures.
expectationText: An elegant little project that combines simple stitches with a clever fold-over design. The eyelet row creates a channel for threading a drawstring.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.instruction: Chain 20. This is the width of the pouch. Work in turned rows.

steps.title: Build the body
steps.instruction: Single crochet into the second chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 1 and turn.

steps.title: Continue the fabric
steps.instruction: Single crochet across for 20 rows to create a rectangle.

steps.title: Make the eyelet row
steps.instruction: Chain 2, skip first stitch, double crochet in next stitch, chain 1, skip 1 stitch, double crochet again. Repeat across to create a row of holes for the drawstring.

steps.title: Create the envelope flap
steps.instruction: Work 6 more rows of single crochet above the eyelet row for the fold-over flap.

steps.title: Fold, seam, and thread
steps.instruction: Fold the rectangle up so the eyelet row sits 6 rows below the fold. Seam the sides. Thread cord through the eyelets and tie ends. Fold over the flap.
